rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: Das Überdruckventil hat unter %s ausgeblasen. Steht die Anzeige am Anschlag, runter vom Gitter.
rows.back: The pressure relief valve vented beneath %s. If the indicator is at its limit, get off the grating.
rows.back_notes: The intransitive use of 'ausgeblasen' is awkward; it suggests blowing out or venting.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.
rows.msgstr: Noch kein Checkpoint. Gespeichert wird ab dem ersten SICHERUNGSPUNKT.
rows.back: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAVE POINT.
rows.back_notes: 'Sicherungspunkt' can mean a save point or a securing point.

rows.msgid: The Director thinks WOLF is still in standby.
rows.msgstr: Der Direktor glaubt, WOLF sei noch im Standby.
rows.back: The Director believes WOLF is still on standby.
rows.back_notes: 'Direktor' is masculine.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.
rows.msgstr:
Niemand gibt einen Aktivierungsbefehl.
WOLF weckt sich selbst.
rows.back:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself up.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
rows.msgstr:
Der Wächter hat %s im Freien gesehen.
Bleib nah am TANKAUSLÖSER.
rows.back:
The guard saw %s outdoors.
Stay close to the TANK TRIGGER.
rows.back_notes: 'Im Freien' means outdoors, rather than necessarily exposed. 'Wächter' is masculine and does not specifically identify a machine.

rows.back: Go right to the circuit breaker.

rows.msgid: Or head right to the breaker.
rows.msgstr: Oder geh nach rechts zum Schutzschalter.
rows.back: Or go right to the circuit breaker.

rows.back_notes: 'Eindämmung' means containment or curbing, not a physical containment area.
Names a technical field or function, not a person or job holder.

rows.msgid: E: read the Director's purge display.
rows.back: E: read the Director's purge display.
rows.back_notes: 'Säuberung' can mean cleaning or a purge. 'Direktor' is masculine.

rows.msgid: HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.
rows.msgstr: HALTEN E: manuellen Bypass kurbeln, %d von %d.
rows.back: HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.
rows.back_notes: 'HALTEN E' has unnatural German word order.

rows.msgid: E: talk to WOLF about the relay.
rows.msgstr: E: Mit WOLF über das Relais sprechen.
rows.back: E: talk with WOLF about the relay.
rows.back_notes: 'Über das Relais' can mean about the relay or via the relay.

rows.msgid: Find the breaker. WOLF will follow your lead.
rows.msgstr: Finde den Schutzschalter. WOLF folgt dir.
rows.back: Find the circuit breaker. WOLF follows you.

rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: La válvula de alivio estalló bajo %s. Cuando el manómetro llegue al máximo, no pises la rejilla.
rows.back: The relief valve burst beneath %s. When the pressure gauge reaches the maximum, do not step on the grating.
rows.back_notes: 'Estalló' means burst or exploded.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.
rows.msgstr: Aún no hay punto de control. Se guarda desde el primer PUNTO SEGURO.
rows.back: There is no checkpoint yet. Saving starts from the first SAFE POINT.

rows.msgid: The Director thinks WOLF is still in standby.
rows.msgstr: El Director cree que WOLF sigue en espera.
rows.back: The Director believes WOLF is still on standby.
rows.back_notes: 'El Director' is masculine.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.
rows.msgstr:
Nadie da una orden de activación.
WOLF se despierta solo.
rows.back:
Nobody gives an activation order.
WOLF wakes up on his own.
rows.back_notes: 'Solo' is masculine and refers to WOLF; it can mean alone or without assistance.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
rows.msgstr:
El centinela vio a %s al descubierto.
Quédate cerca de SOLTAR TANQUE.
rows.back:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to RELEASE TANK.
rows.back_notes: 'SOLTAR TANQUE' is an action phrase used awkwardly as a location label. 'El centinela' is masculine.

rows.msgstr: Ve a la derecha, al interruptor.
rows.back: Go to the right, to the switch.

rows.msgid: Or head right to the breaker.
rows.msgstr: O ve a la derecha, al interruptor.
rows.back: Or go to the right, to the switch.

rows.msgstr: E: leer la pantalla de purga del Director.
rows.back: E: read the Director's purge screen.
rows.back_notes: 'Director' is masculine.

rows.msgid: HOLD E: crank the manual bypass, %d of %d.
rows.msgstr: MANTÉN E: girar el bypass manual, %d de %d.

rows.msgid: Find the breaker. WOLF will follow your lead.

rows.back: Find the switch. WOLF will follow your footsteps.
rows.back_notes: 'Seguir tus pasos' can also mean following your example.

rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: %sの足元でリリーフベントが噴き出した。ゲージが振り切れたら、格子から離れること。
rows.back: The relief vent erupted at %s's feet. When the gauge goes off the scale, move away from the grating.
rows.back_notes: 'リリーフベント' is a transliterated technical term. '格子' can mean a lattice, bars or grating.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.
rows.msgstr: チェックポイントはまだない。最初のセーフポイントから保存される。
rows.back: There is no checkpoint yet. Saving starts from the first safe point.

rows.msgid: The Director thinks WOLF is still in standby.
rows.msgstr: 所長は、WOLFがまだ待機状態だと思っている。
rows.back: The facility head thinks WOLF is still on standby.
rows.back_notes: '所長' means the head of a facility or institution and is not gendered.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.
rows.msgstr:
誰も起動命令を出していない。
WOLFは自ら目を覚ます。
rows.back:
Nobody has issued a startup order.
WOLF wakes up on his own.
rows.back_notes: The source does not grammatically gender WOLF.

rows.msgid:
The sentry saw %s out in the open.
Stay close to the TANK RELEASE.
rows.msgstr:
セントリーが開けた場所にいる%sを見つけた。
タンク投下の近くにいること。
rows.back:
The sentry spotted %s in an open area.
Stay near the tank drop.
rows.back_notes: 'タンク投下' means dropping a tank; no switch or control is explicitly named.

rows.msgstr: 右のブレーカーへ向かう。
rows.back: Head toward the breaker on the right.

rows.msgid: Or head right to the breaker.
rows.msgstr: または右のブレーカーへ。
rows.back: Or toward the breaker on the right.
rows.back_notes: The verb is omitted.
'収容' can mean housing, confinement or containment.

rows.msgid: The relief vent let go under %s. When the gauge peaks, stay off the grate.
rows.msgstr: Сорвало предохранительный клапан, а %s — прямо на решётке. Когда стрелка манометра на пределе, не стой на решётке.
rows.back: The safety valve was blown off, and %s is right on the grating. When the pressure gauge needle is at its limit, do not stand on the grating.

rows.msgid: No checkpoint yet. Saving starts at the first SAFE POINT.

rows.msgstr: Директор думает, что WOLF всё ещё в режиме ожидания.
rows.back: The Director thinks WOLF is still in standby mode.
rows.back_notes: 'Директор' is a grammatically masculine job noun.

rows.msgid:
Nobody gives an activation command.
WOLF wakes himself.

Никто не отдаёт команду на активацию.
WOLF просыпается сам.

WOLF wakes up on his own.
